title: Prysm RAG and Chat
content: The Prysm chatbot provides public project knowledge and authorized investigation explanations. Public chat retrieves only approved knowledge documents. Authorized chat receives a bounded, backend-built investigation context after authentication, permission, clearance, ownership, and resource checks. The chatbot does not independently authorize users or query unrestricted operational data. Gemini generates concise grounded language when available; otherwise a deterministic local fallback returns relevant retrieved facts.
